titles.native: 漆黒のシャガ THE ANIMATION

description:
Based on an original story by Seven.

Shaga the Monster who has lived for 300 years in the forest with other monsters. Now try for a new life by traveling with a young man who was asked by the Mother of the youth to keep her son in escorting to Osshu. They started the journey and met with a variety of monsters.

(Source: Nekopoi)
